description: TrustyAIService is the Schema for the trustyaiservices API

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: TrustyAIServiceSpec defines the desired state of TrustyAIService

status.description: TrustyAIServiceStatus defines the observed state of TrustyAIService

conditions.description: Conditions represent the latest available observations of the service's state.

items.description:
TASCondition mirrors metav1.Condition for platform contract compliance (RHOAIENG-67659),
but keeps lastTransitionTime, reason, and message optional to preserve backward
compatibility with conditions stored by prior operator versions.

lastTransitionTime.description: lastTransitionTime is when the condition last changed status.

message.description: message is a human-readable description of the condition.

observedGeneration.description: observedGeneration is the generation when this condition was last set.

reason.description: reason is a CamelCase identifier for the condition's cause.

status.description: status is the condition status: True, False, or Unknown.

type.description: type is the condition type in CamelCase.

observedGeneration.description: ObservedGeneration is the last generation reconciled by the controller

phase.description: Phase represents the current phase of the service

ready.description:
Ready indicates whether the service is ready
Deprecated: Use Conditions with type "Ready" instead

replicas.description: Replicas is the number of running replicas
